description: Generated GUID values through DAO: G(ID COUNTER key, U GUID) takes three rows from INSERT ... VALUES (GenGUID()) and one literal '{00112233-4455-6677-8899-AABBCCDDEEFF}'; DDL 'U GUID DEFAULT GenGUID()' is attempted; and G3 gets a GUID field by CreateField(15) with DefaultValue 'GenGUID()' and takes three rows without naming it. Errors, the stored U values, their length as text and the number of distinct values are read.
